rotation.name: 璇玑引星剑 · 蓄力一回合

implementation_decisions.transition_round_remainder: cancel old enemy intent; block further boss damage; start P2 next round with public intent
implementation_decisions.spatial_model: three adjacent reachable handles; pointer one-step rotation; setup inputs consume no combat action/time; release is normal action
implementation_decisions.shield: 20% phase maximum; replacement not stacking; reflection active while shield remains, incoming damage including absorbed damage
implementation_decisions.intent_schedule: 10 public beats: charge/release/thrust/recovery/recovery/shield/recovery/thrust/recovery/recovery. Shield replenished once per numeric phase; later shield slots publicly recover. Explicit old-injury recovery balances unprescribed AI frequency; source panels/multipliers unchanged.
implementation_decisions.checkpoint: trusted history prefix at each numeric phase start; no reward/refill on retry
